 Kinolune OS 0.1.0 - Installer                                      Step 2 of 7

 System disk
 Choose a disk. EVERYTHING ON IT WILL BE ERASED. Other disks are not touched.

 > ! Kingston SNV2S1000G         1.0 TB  NVMe      /dev/nvme0n1  S/N ...CDEF
   ! Seagate ST4000VN008-2DR166  4.0 TB  SATA HDD  /dev/sda      S/N ...ABCD
   ! Seagate ST4000VN008-2DR166  4.0 TB  SATA HDD  /dev/sdb      S/N ...EFGH
   ! Toshiba MG08ACA16TE          16 TB  SATA HDD  /dev/sdc      S/N ...FVGG

 Will be erased: /dev/nvme0n1
   - GPT partition table, 3 partition(s)
   - boot partition of another OS (/dev/nvme0n1p1)
   - ext4 "boot" on /dev/nvme0n1p2
     and 1 more

 Not offered:
   - Kingston DataTraveler 3.0 31 GB /dev/sde: the installer boots from it





 Up/Down: disk  Enter: choose  R: rescan  Esc: back  Ctrl+C: exit
